full_text: Plaintiff's Claim and ORDER to Go to Small Claims Court, Form SC-100, Page 2 of 6. Item 1: The plaintiff is Nicolas Hernandez. Item 2: The defendant is Local Initiative Health Authority for Los Angeles, 1200 W. 7th Street, Los Angeles, CA 90017. Item 3: The plaintiff claims the defendant owes $3,115.73. Why does the defendant owe the plaintiff money? Defendant, a Knox-Keene licensed health plan, breached its non-delegable duty to maintain an adequate provider network (HSC § 1367) and failed to timely adjudicate a DHCS-directed Conlan reimbursement claim within the mandatory 30-day window under AB 3275. Defendant further failed to provide mandated Non-Emergency Medical Transportation for pharmacy access. These statutory defaults directly caused Claimant $3,115.73 in documented out-of-pocket medical and transportation expenses. Negligence per se under Evidence Code § 669. Pre-suit Gov. Claim LMR-9059 filed 05/28/2026; rejected 07/13/2026.
